newsitem.title: USA: Internet unit to merge with Anschutz unit.
newsitem.headline: Internet unit to merge with Anschutz unit.

text.p: Internet Communications Corp said on Thursday that its shareholders approved a merger between one of its subsidiaries and Interwest Communications, an affiliate of The Anschutz Corp.
Internet received all Interwest stock for 49 percent of Internet common stock, it said in a statement.
Internet shareholders also agreed to increase the number of outstanding shares to 20 million from 4.5 million, it said.
The share increase would give Internet Communications more flexibility in conducting the transaction, it said.
The combined company would create a dominant regional network solutions provider, Internet said.
Interwest designs and supports customer premise equipment for voice applications. Interwest was expected to be fully-integrated by January 31, 1997.
